subject: Phase-gate rollout and key issuance for Spruce expansion
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@sablehealth.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Phase-gate rollout and key issuance for Spruce expansion

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks again for the productive QBR last week. We want to move ahead with the next phase of our contract: adding 8 new internal applications across three squads. High-level asks:
- Short pilot (3 apps) to start July 26 for validation
- Staggered activation for remaining 5 apps across Aug–Sep
- Separate API keys per app + rotation policy
- Updated term language for the renewal (we'd like the additional apps to prorate to our existing renewal cycle)

I've attached the requested apps list with estimated monthly token volumes for each (Spruce_Requested_Apps_List.xlsx). Can you confirm:
1) Recommended deployment approach (hosted vs. dedicated) for those volumes
2) Whether you can issue per-app keys automatically or if we need to create service accounts on our side
3) Any impact to pricing or credits given we are increasing committed units and near-term capacity

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call — availability below if that helps: Tue 7/6 09:00–11:00 PT or Wed 7/7 13:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Director, Platform Integrations
SableHealth

Attachment: Spruce_Requested_Apps_List.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 KB)

From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@sablehealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phase-gate rollout and key issuance for Spruce expansion

Maria —

Appreciate the clear ask and the spreadsheet — that helps. Proposed approach (high level):

Phase-gate rollout (recommended)
- Phase 1 (pilot): 3 apps -> provisioned in hosted mode on existing tenant, one key per app, run for 4 weeks
- Phase 2 (scale): remaining 5 apps -> convert high-throughput apps to Dedicated pool if latency/throughput needs exceed hosted SLOs

Key issuance
- We can create a unique API key per app and register each key to a namespace tied to the Spruce tenant. Keys support rotation and a 30/60/90-day rotation policy (we will provide runbook for automation).

Terms and credits
- Because this increases committed units we can offer a prorated credit applied to the current renewal cycle — draft language in the attached MOU (MOU_draft_Spruce_v1.docx). Any material change to SLA or dedicated capacity would need an addendum.

Next steps
1) Review the attached MOU draft and confirm the pilot apps list (we used your spreadsheet to pick 3 pilot candidates).
2) Book a 30-minute alignment call — I can do Tue 7/6 10:30 PT or Wed 7/7 14:00 PT.
3) Once MOU is agreed, we’ll provision pilot keys within 48 hours and share the key-provisioning runbook.

I copied Ben (ops) and Lauren (CS) for technical and renewal coordination.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MOU_draft_Spruce_v1.docx (document, 28 KB)

From: James Patel <j.patel@sablehealth.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@sablehealth.com>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phase-gate rollout and key issuance for Spruce expansion

Kimberly —

Thanks, that plan looks reasonable. We can confirm pilot candidates by EOD Tue. A couple of quick clarifying items:
- On API keys vs service accounts: security prefers per-app keys tied to our internal vaults. Is there a way to automate key rotation from your end so we don't have to rotate manually every 30 days?
- On credits/proration: can you confirm the credit will be reflected as an invoice credit on the next renewal invoice? We prefer written confirmation before we sign the MOU.

We are available Tue 7/6 at 10:30 PT (matches your slot) — please send calendar invite.

Thanks,
James Patel
Engineering Manager — Infrastructure
SableHealth

Subject: Re: Phase-gate rollout and key issuance for Spruce expansion

Quick technical note —

We support per-app API keys and can wire up automatic rotation. Two options for Sable:
1) Redwood-managed keys + webhook to your vault on rotation (we push new key material to a secure endpoint)
2) You manage keys via service accounts and call our token-exchange endpoint for short-lived tokens (recommended if you need tighter PKI control)

For the pilot I recommend Redwood-managed keys with rotation TTL=30 days so we can move quickly; we’ll provide the automation example in the runbook. If Sable prefers option 2, that’s fine but there’s a ~3-day extra setup window.

Attaching the provisioning runbook; it has API calls, sample curl snippets, and the rotation webhooks.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks for confirming pilot apps earlier this week. Recap and firmed timeline below:

1) Signed MOU (draft attached in earlier thread) + written confirmation on prorated credit (we will reflect the credit on the next invoice and include the line item in the renewal addendum).
2) Pilot provisioning (Phase 1) — target start: Mon Jul 26. We will provision three host-mode keys on Jul 24 and share access details.
3) Pilot runbook — Ben will share implementation samples and the rotation webhook by COB Mon Jul 12.
4) Phase 2 (scale) — tentative Aug 30 start; decision point Aug 16 to evaluate Dedicated conversion.

Deal reference: SD-4821. I’ve added a DocuSign link to the MOU in HubSpot (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/52341/SD-4821). Once we have the signed MOU we’ll open the provisioning ticket and schedule the runbook walkthrough with your engineers.

If anything changes on your side, flag it here; otherwise I’ll send the calendar invite for Tue 7/6 10:30 PT to finalize the MOU.

Best,
Kimberly Park
